Alex Gehaz Malasusa succeeded Stephen Moshi, whom you wrote as Stefano, as presiding bishop of the Evangelical Lutheran Church in Tanzania in 2017. The team note naming Rev. Dr. Samson Mushemba as Moshi's immediate successor doesn't match that, and I can't verify it from here. I haven't checked a current source, so later leadership changes wouldn't be reflected.

CONFIDENCE: 70
